newsitem.title: USA: National City's president to retire.
newsitem.headline: National City's president to retire.

text.p: National City Corp Monday said its president, William Robertson, intends to retire July 31, 1997, following more than three decades of service to the Cleveland-based holding company.
There are no immediate plans to name a replacement.

Robertson, 55, has been president since October 1995, after serving as deputy chairman since 1987 and a director since 1988. Robertson will remain a board member and stands for re-election as a board member at National City's annual shareholders meeting on April 14, 1997.
